spans.s:
तोद m. (-दः)
 1. Pain, anguish, vexation, torture, uneasiness, (either of
body or mind.)
 2. Sharp, shooting or pricking pain.
 E. तुद् to teaze
or torment, affix भावे घञ्.

तोदन n. (-नं)
 1. A goad: see तोत्र.
 2. Pain, affliction from disease, &c.
E. तुद् to give pain, affix करणे ल्युट् ।
